blocks.1: SONG FOR THE FESTIVAL OF LIGHT IN EIVINDVIK
blocks.2: We have got electric light in our village,
blocks.3: it is strange for an old-timer of 80
blocks.4: to turn a tiny little black thing
blocks.5: and then there is light everywhere all around.
blocks.6: Yes, this electric is a strange fellow,
blocks.7: he seems to like making fools of old folk,
blocks.8: and sometimes he hisses and is angry and sour,
blocks.9: and at times he lies so nicely in wait.
blocks.10: I was going to screw something the wrong way into a funny thing,
blocks.11: but first I felt in the hole with my forefinger,
blocks.12: but in there the rascal lay quietly in wait
blocks.13: and hit me over the hand with a hard stick.
blocks.14: Before, when I had gone to bed and wanted to sleep in peace,
blocks.15: I always used to turn the lamp down;
blocks.16: I did so like having a little light
blocks.17: so I could see the blanket on me when I lay freezing.
blocks.18: But this new lamp I can't get the hang of;
blocks.19: I am ever so careful when I turn it down,
blocks.20: but either it shines both bright and fine (?)
blocks.21: or else it's the opposite and it goes out completely.
blocks.22: Before, I always used to light a fire for warmth
blocks.23: in the morning to make myself a cup of coffee,
blocks.24: but this cooker here I can't get going,
blocks.25: it won't draw with either kindling or wood.
blocks.26: You know there is a big door on the cooker,
blocks.27: and I, I did just as I always did before:
blocks.28: I filled the space in there with kindling and wood,
blocks.29: lit a good fire and then shut the door.
blocks.30: But would you believe it, the rascal went right out;
blocks.31: it would not burn, but smoked terribly.
blocks.32: So I got down on my knees and blew and blew,
blocks.33: but I can't get this new stove going.
blocks.34: They put in something for me called Pyrox,
blocks.35: and from it a cord runs over to a black box;
blocks.36: I didn't think much more about it then,
blocks.37: I thought it was something to sit on.
blocks.38: Yes, this little stool in my room
blocks.39: I sat down on to rest a while,
blocks.40: but after a while I felt there was a smell of burning;
blocks.41: I could not understand who had lit it.
blocks.42: When I was going to get up again after a little while,
blocks.43: it was blazing and burning in my backside,
blocks.44: and if the chamber pot had not stood there with something in it,
blocks.45: that would have been the end of me.
blocks.46: I have grown up here in the village and here I was born,
blocks.47: and I thought I would stay here until I died,
blocks.48: but since this nasty electric came
blocks.49: I could do nothing but change my mind.
blocks.50: Now I will move away to Neverdal
blocks.51: and live there until one day I move for good;
blocks.52: even if the electric is strong and goes dangerously fast,
blocks.53: he will never dare go as far as Neverdal.
